crossRefs.note: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I…
Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;
We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

translations.web: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.
translations.bsb: For you have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed our temple nor blasphemed our goddess.
translations.kjv: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.
translations.asv: For ye have brought hither these men, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of our goddess.
